notes.title: How to access the first version of 2.0
notes.content:
If you have bought the game:

1. Locate HoD: A pirate adventure in your library

2.. Right click on the game in your library - Then go to the beta tab and select "alpha_tester", restart Steam afterwards

If you haven't bought the game:

1. Look through your mail until you see a mail from us with a beta key

2. Add the key to your Steam

3. Install the game and click play.

notes.title: You have full access!
notes.content:
1. We have added the old game back (it will remain there until we release the new update)

2. Everyone who bought the old game can now test our first test build for free.
- You right click on the game, choose properties - Clck on the beta tab and then chose "alpha_tester". THe game will then download a limited version of the new update.

3. To those people who do not have the old game - We are sending out beta test keys as fast as we can!

Report bugs to Squadleader32 on Steam or mail us at:

mail@hjocreations.com

You can also go to the contact pages on:

www.hodgame.com
www.hjocreations.com

We are available 24/7 all year round. (Usually Squadleader32 is)

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
Update 1.7 is now up and running on all available platforms.

Windows
Mac OS X
Linux

We also have full support for 64-bit and 32-bit.

A lot of people had problems with the current build being deleted in an empty update from Steam, this will however not happen again.

We had to make a better structure of all the builds and platforms etc, it was better to do it now, we think it would have been a lot worse if we had waited with this.

notes.title: Changing some things - Update 1.7
notes.content:
There is a new build coming up and unfortunatly it seems to have affected the current build.

Before we had three depots (Windows, Mac and Linux) with executables that were configured so they could launch in both 32/64.

However that seems to have caused problems for some people.

So we decided to create 6 depots,

Windows 32-bit
WIndows 64-bit
Linux 32-bit
Linux 64-bit
OSX 32-bit
OSX 64-bit

SInce we are uploading 6 builds right now, Steam had a little trouble figuring out which build to download since we had 3 builds before and now we have 6 builds. 

That is why Steam does not download any files right now, so if you still have the old update (the new update cleans the game on the hdd while the build is uploading) set the game so it doesn't update.

However, the builds are almost finished uploading and it should be up within an hour or so.

*The saves in the game will not be affected.

notes.title: Why and why not
notes.content:
I realize that some people are a bit concerned regarding the fact that I didn't set this game as a "early-access" version.

I however, want to point out a few things that might clearify this.

I love critisism and I support everyone who wants to make their voice heard here.

The game was ticked as an "early-access" just yesterday, before the release. However, I changed that to a full-version release. 

Maybe that was a stupid mistake, maybe not. But this version that is out now is a fully playable game, and I don't have any intentions of making changes according to suggestions since I already have a lot of ideas that I want to implement to this game. 

*However, I am not saying that I don't want suggestions, I am just saying that this release was not intended for the community to follow the game as it progresses.*

We have a finalized version, and I thought it was a better way to show you what is coming and to make you exited - and to play the game and enjoy it as it is right now.

I'll be honest with you, I am not a developer in my "base-knowledge". I am a 20 year old guy who has created 2 companies in order to change the world. HJO Creations is working towards sustainability and creativity in these sort of areas. 

My goal is to create 3 high quality games.

1. Hands on Deck
2. RoboDome
3. Planetize

I am going to do everything I can in order to make these games as unique as possible, this is my first time I am launching a game such as this on Steam, I am learning and I will now know how to proceed with my future games thanks to you guys!

I appreciate every word and every opinion you have on this game and I will make sure to deliver what you ask for.

Squadleader32 out,
